results.title: Chiara Bonacchi's Post - LinkedIn
results.content: 🔥Really excited that our \*new paper\* connecting museum visitors' political attitudes with their understanding of the past is finally out 🔥 This study is the first to quantitatively investigate museum visitors’ perceptions of historical analogies that compare concepts from the deep past to modern political ideas. ⁉️What are the political attitudes of archaeological museum visitors? ⁉️What potential do these museums have to engage visitors with authoritarian views and foster tolerance? 🗿🗿To answer these questions, we collected data from 803 visitors at three archaeological museums in the UK. Our findings show that: ✔️ visitors’ views do not align with the positions implied by the historical analogies used in exclusive nationalist discourse ✔️ by contrast, most participants hold critical and non-binary understandings of the Iron Age and Roman past, as well as liberal values ✔️ museums have a limited ability to attract adults with authoritarian views and to alter their beliefs through ad-hoc interventions in the form of in-situ displays. ## Sign in to view more content.
